points.why: Proposes a weekend-hours cap and a rework reserve as the parameter, rated low-to-mid power and high reach.
Proposes a scope-before-hours rule with sign-off and net-velocity planning, rated mid power.
Redefines release success as hitting the date at sustainable cost, rated high power and low reach.
Rates power and reach in separate columns and labels the cap a stopgap that buys time for the scope rule.
